answer: What survives to the cedar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the island until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sable of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
